entry.title: BILL043(26) (Honolulu): PUBLISH → ZON
entry.content:
TO REZONE LAND SITUATED AT PAʻALAʻA KAI, WAIALUA, OʻAHU, HAWAIʻI.

Rezones land situated at 66-9A Waialua Beach Road, Waialua, identified as Tax Map Key 6-6-018:024 (portion) from the County District to the R-5 Residential District.
